summary: The campaign is incomplete against the stated targets and needs one production fix. Saved and recomputed metrics agree: one Zoomies app component, line coverage 61.57% to 75.77%, branch coverage unverified at 0 counters, max complexity 20 with 48 bodies over 8, max line-based CRAP 72 with 108 bodies over 8, 997 bodies and 0 unmapped. Final XCTest evidence is 361 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, plus 1 excluded visible-window test and 3 passing measurement tests. The new file-size check uses a 32-bit NSNumber conversion on the image safety gate.
findings: Defect: Sources/ImageSafety.swift:110-112 replaced 64-bit URL.fileSize with NSNumber.intValue, which is Int32. A file whose size does not fit in Int32 is measured incorrectly. If the low 32 bits are positive and no greater than the 256MB cap at Sources/ImageSafety.swift:34, inspectFile and boundedFileData can treat a multi-gigabyte file as small enough to open. Use int64Value or an unsigned 64-bit size, and reject when the attribute is missing or does not fit.

Unreported behavior change: full-screen capture no longer reports a missing display ID. The old captureRegion path presented "Screenshot failed" / "Unable to determine display ID." Sources/ScreenshotService.swift:326-333 now returns nil when displayID is missing, and captureFullScreen at lines 119-120 returns without an alert. Area capture was already silent in that case.

Evidence limitation, not a restored-source test failure: 12 of 31 distinct mutations were run against file bytes that are not the final checkout, including every ScreenRecordingService trial and the stale-URL-size trial. Each mutated snippet still occurs once in the final file, and each trial restored its own pre-mutation bytes, but those logs do not prove the final files. The later symlink-size mutation does match final ImageSafety.swift.

No false completion claim. The gate exit is 1, targets_met is false, branch percent is null, and CRAP exceptions are empty. LLVM region kinds in the final export are only code (0) and skipped (2); there are no branch regions. Whole-app line totals recomputed from coverage.json are 8603/11354. CRAP matches C²*(1-coverage)³+C on every scored body. Declaration-only files are NotePanelLayout.swift and ScreenshotFinalAction.swift. All 55 handwritten Sources files are in the inventory.

Recording destination-failure preservation in the final source is coherent. ScreenRecordingService.swift:267-271 deletes the temp file only when not publishing. publishSession at lines 342-347 keeps it when the move fails. The final test at Tests/ZoomiesTests/ScreenRecordingServiceTests.swift:199-222 asserts that. Its mutation log predates the final file bytes.

Final ordinary tests were rerun after the mutation log. tests.log ends with Executed 361 tests, 0 failures, and contains no skip. tool-tests.log is 3 tests, OK. The two initial mutation errors are signal 5 / a nil unwrap in RenameInputContractTests and were not counted as detections; attempt 2 of each was detected. Source SHA-256 files saved at 21:01 match the current tree. HEAD is still 65024113deefe947b11ebda0a2d4dc0419cb8084; the campaign is uncommitted.
